did: Game day's phone half of three Game Week Bites stories landed. In Takes, a bite's row now says the play home matched it to, its unit and its half. The phone reads scenario catalog v2: halftime, the onside kick, halves and big plays. "Every scenario" is now one list ranked by what is plausible now, opened from a floating bubble. While a bite is said, a one-tap chip says which unit it is about, and a switch moves it to the other team. A play that just happened names its own unit. Along the way, the check that a tap moves nothing on a phone screen stopped reading a button fixed to the window as moving when the page scrolled under it.

calls.title: Where the matched play shows: in Takes, not a new Bites page
options: Say the matched play in Takes' bite line, filtered to a game
Build a separate Bites page in Game day
Wait for the whole page before showing anything
calls.why: Takes already lists every bite by game and plays it; a second page would be a copy of it.
calls.undo: Move the line onto a Bites page if Takes stops listing bites by game (C855).

calls.title: Catalog v2's words, icons and closed dimensions on the phone
options: These words and icons, with halves and big plays as closed unions
Read the dimensions as plain strings and show the server's slugs
Leave the dimensions out until a surface shows them
calls.why: A value either side adds then fails until the other side has it, instead of showing a slug.

calls.title: The ranked list and the unit chip on Game day
options: The ranked list in place of the sheet, a floating bubble, and a one-tap unit chip while the bite is said
A second ranked list beside the Every scenario sheet
A unit picker of four buttons after the bite stops, during Undo
calls.why: One list, always in reach, and the unit is named while the moment is fresh and sent once with the bite.
calls.undo: Put the sheet back behind the header's button and drop the chip (C857).
